title: Hilbert scheme of points on non-reduced nodal curves
summary: We construct a stratification of the punctual Hilbert scheme of points on a non-reduced and nodal plane curve, $x^uy^v=0$. Each stratum is indexed by a new combinatorial object we define: a weak diagonal partition. The approach is based on introducing filtrations on ideals, together with a valuation adapted to the non-reduced structure, which allows us to analyze generators and their degrees of freedom in a systematic way.
